title: Admin Web V2 Product Architecture
problem: Admin Web V0 proved the app and generated Admin API contract, but V2 needs route-first product architecture, shared UI vocabulary, and stack decisions before deeper workflows are implemented.
gates: cd apps/admin-web && npm run generate:admin-api && npm run check && npm run test && npm run build
Browser/Playwright smoke at http://127.0.0.1:5174/ for visible UI changes
cargo nextest run -p nako-api admin_contract --no-fail-fast when Admin API contract source changes
cargo nextest run -p nako-api typescript --no-fail-fast when Admin API contract generation changes

continue_policy.notes: AWV2-040 is complete. Continue with AWV2-050 closeout-or-split review. Prefer splitting focused workflow lanes such as Jobs, Media Libraries, Catalog Governance, Addons, or Settings over continuing a broad app rewrite. Keep /legacy until migrated workflows have route tests and browser evidence.
